modules.name: Diabetes Panel
modules.description: Tracks A1c, glucose, diabetes complications monitoring, and ADA guidelines.
modules.message: Your records suggest diabetes or diabetes treatment. Enable the Diabetes Panel for A1c tracking, monitoring reminders, and ADA-aligned guidance.

modules.name: Prediabetes / Metabolic Risk Panel
modules.description: Tracks metabolic risk, A1c trend, lifestyle factors, and prevention strategies.
modules.message: Your A1c or diagnosis suggests prediabetes or metabolic risk. Enable this panel for monitoring and prevention guidance.

modules.name: Liver Health Panel
modules.description: Tracks ALT, AST, bilirubin, liver imaging, and hepatitis screening.
modules.message: Elevated liver enzymes or a liver-related diagnosis detected. Enable the Liver Health Panel for trend tracking and screening guidance.

modules.name: Kidney Health Panel
modules.description: Tracks eGFR, creatinine, BMP/CMP labs, proteinuria, and KDIGO guidelines.
modules.message: Your records suggest kidney disease or reduced kidney function. Enable the Kidney Health Panel.

modules.name: Pregnancy Panel
modules.description: Tracks prenatal labs, BP, symptoms, and obstetric milestones.
modules.message: A pregnancy diagnosis or positive pregnancy test was found. Enable the Pregnancy Panel for prenatal tracking.

modules.name: Thyroid Panel
modules.description: Tracks TSH, T4, thyroid medication dosing, and monitoring reminders.
modules.message: Thyroid findings or medication detected. Enable the Thyroid Panel for TSH tracking and monitoring reminders.

modules.name: Dialysis Panel
modules.description: Tracks dialysis sessions, access, labs, weight, and dialysis-specific monitoring.
modules.message: Dialysis diagnosis or related medication found. Enable the Dialysis Panel for session tracking and monitoring.

modules.name: Anticoagulation Panel
modules.description: Tracks INR, anticoagulant dosing, bleeding risk, and clotting history.
modules.message: An anticoagulant medication was found. Enable the Anticoagulation Panel for INR tracking and safety monitoring.

modules.name: Cardiac / Hypertension Panel
modules.description: Tracks BP, lipids, cardiac medications, and ACC/AHA guideline alignment.
modules.message: Cardiac or hypertension diagnoses or medications found. Enable the Cardiac Panel for BP tracking and cardiovascular monitoring.

modules.name: Asthma / COPD Panel
modules.description: Tracks inhaler use, exacerbations, peak flow, and pulmonary function trends.
modules.message: Asthma or COPD diagnosis or inhalers found. Enable this panel for exacerbation tracking and pulmonary monitoring.

modules.name: Mental Health Panel
modules.description: Tracks mood, medications, therapy notes, and PHQ/GAD screening.
modules.message: Mental health diagnoses or psychiatric medications found. Enable the Mental Health Panel for mood tracking and medication management.

modules.name: Cancer History / Survivorship Panel
modules.description: Tracks cancer history, treatment, survivorship monitoring, and screening.
modules.message: A cancer diagnosis was found in your records. Enable the Cancer Survivorship Panel for follow-up tracking and monitoring reminders.

modules.name: Lipid / Cholesterol Panel
modules.description: Tracks LDL, HDL, triglycerides, statin use, and cardiovascular risk.
modules.message: Elevated lipids or cholesterol-related medications found. Enable the Lipid Panel for trend tracking and cardiovascular risk assessment.

modules.name: Bone Health / Osteoporosis Panel
modules.description: Tracks DEXA, fracture history, calcium/vitamin D, and bisphosphonate use.
modules.message: Osteoporosis-related findings detected. Enable the Bone Health Panel for density tracking and fracture risk assessment.
